title: Deeper/broader source-to-output loss-chain audit across DWG/DXF peers
mode: Primary-source project documentation, issue/PR review, and local plan/source audit
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Refresh source-to-output evidence across open-source DWG readers/writers, DXF readers/writers, and downstream consumer routes
Separate omitted entity shells from retained shells with missing inline or external ACIS payloads
Reconcile peer release/branch status and documented applicability with existing PAR-07/S8 and modeler/AcDs owners
Refine the composed evidence ledger and test readiness without adding duplicate findings or routine validation work

sources.name: ACadSharp DWG-to-DXF omission report and linked writer branch
sources.observed: Issue #1195 remains open and reports ACadSharp 3.4.9 reading 3DSOLID/REGION shells but omitting them from DXF, including solid-only block definitions. The reporter gives counts of 252 solids in one drawing and 51 solids plus 3 regions in another, and says LibreDWG was used to cross-check the source census. Linked PR #1240 remains open and undeployed, depends on #1174, and describes ModelerGeometry serialization in DwgObjectWriter; this is not evidence that the reported DxfWriter omission is fixed.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Peer issue report and undeployed branch description, not a reproduced current release result or a libdxfrw defect.

sources.name: LibreDWG modern AcDs carrier-loss report and project notes
sources.observed: Open issue #1411 reports against LibreDWG 0.14.8593 that R2013+ modeler entity shells survive while AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b SAB payload is absent; the scratch reproducer reports a 5,489-byte SAB body. LibreDWG NEWS describes modern AcDsPrototype_1b handling as incomplete/unreliable. These are peer/version-scoped observations, not universal current-master or local-code results.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Issue/release-note evidence; no peer binary was run in this review.

sources.name: ezdxf current release and ACIS scope
sources.observed: The current documentation identifies ezdxf 1.4.5 with ASCII/Binary DXF read/write and third-party-content retention, while the ACIS-specific route says it can read SAT/SAB but writes SAT only, supports a limited number of ACIS entities, and may load unsupported ACIS entities as NONE_ENTITY with loss on re-export.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Official project documentation of scope; not an arbitrary-ACIS round-trip or independent B-rep semantic result.

sources.name: FreeCAD importer and DWG conversion route
sources.observed: FreeCAD documents DWG handling as external converter to DXF followed by the selected DXF importer and says stock DXF import cannot read embedded ACIS blobs. Its documentation names a separate CADExchanger workbench for 3D DWG conversion. The current importDWG.py source shows converter invocations as an orchestration layer distinct from the DXF importer.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Current project route documentation/source; no Linux or Windows application qualification was run.

sources.name: IxMilia.Dxf declared profile and writer caveats
sources.observed: The README declares a DXF-only R10-R2014 scope with listed entity gaps and warns that some written entity classes may not be accepted by AutoCAD, while other entities can require additional fields.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Mutable self-published scope and caveats, not runtime or DWG/ACIS evidence.

localEvidence: Existing PAR-07/S8 and modeler/AcDs plan sections already distinguish entity shells, inline carriers, external AcDs records, owner association, output writing, independent geometry semantics, and consumer acceptance; this review makes the composed per-source-object ledger explicit without adding a new owner

Existing local modeler/block controls include block-contained entities and carrier-preservation/refusal cases; the next combined checkpoint should explicitly pair a solid-only block with a modern handle-linked AcDs carrier without committing external drawings
Existing FreeCAD qualification is a converter-to-DXF-to-importer route and must not be scored as ACIS semantics when the selected stock importer excludes ACIS blobs
PAR-139.3 is the current local implementation slice and remains independent of this research-only evidence update

assessment.existingOwner: PAR-07/S8 plus existing modeler and AcDs carrier owners
assessment.planImpact: Make the PAR-07/S8 composed ledger explicitly stage-aware: source object and placement, decoded shell, inline/side-section carrier, owner/key association, destination membership and carrier, strict parse, geometry semantics, and consumer acceptance. Keep the local fast-slice cadence and existing implementation order. Do not infer deployed DXF writer behavior from an open PR or FreeCAD ACIS semantics from its stock converter/importer route.

method.kind: Read-only web research and local plan/source inspection
method.limitations: Peer issue reports, mutable documentation, and open/unreleased branches are evidence about the cited versions and routes only. They neither establish current behavior across all releases nor prove a libdxfrw defect. This research pass did not validate the active uncommitted PAR-139 code or run any external consumer.
